fact: The FY2021 ex-post evaluation states that the MMS relied on low-resolution Meteosat satellite images (15 to 30 minute interval) for cyclone tracking before the 2019 radar, and that it issues four levels of cyclone warnings.
title: FY2021 Ex-Post Evaluation Report of Japanese Grant Aid Project: The Project for Improvement of Meteorological Radar System (I) (II)
